ofertas.correo_limite: Record the email already sent with the description, duration and requirements. This declaration does not prove delivery.
ofertas.correo_fecha: Email date and time (required, Madrid time)
ofertas.correo_declarado: HR declared an external email dated {fecha}. Delivery is unverified.
ofertas.publicada: Offer published. The declared deadline ends on {vence}.
ofertas.publicada_antes: The offer was already published with this same request.
ofertas.vacio: This job pool has no published offers.
ofertas.sin_respuesta_cuando: You can mark "Did not reply" once the deadline passes
ofertas.directo_por_politica: The job pool policy moves this post to a direct call-up
ofertas.espera_anterior: Will be called once the previous post is settled
ofertas.directo_siguiente: Next step: direct call-up in job pool order
ofertas.confirmar_adjudicada: Award post {plaza} to order no. {orden}? They must reply within the deadline.
ofertas.confirmar_adjudicada_telematica: Award post {plaza} to order no. {orden}, who already accepted within the deadline?
ofertas.confirmar_llamamiento_directo: Move post {plaza} to a direct call-up?
ofertas.confirmar_sin_respuesta: Record that no. {orden} did not reply in time for post {plaza}?
ofertas.hecho_adjudicada: Post {plaza} awarded to order no. {orden}. Record their reply when it arrives.
ofertas.hecho_adjudicada_telematica: Post {plaza} awarded to order no. {orden}, who accepted within the deadline.
ofertas.hecho_llamamiento_directo: Post {plaza} moves to a direct call-up.
ofertas.error_carga: The offers could not be loaded. Press Retry.
ofertas.error_403: Your session cannot manage this job pool’s offers. Ask the job pool’s manager for permission.
ofertas.error_409_clave_divergente: That request was already used with different data. Check the form.
ofertas.error_409_oferta_ya_resuelta: This offer was settled earlier and no longer accepts changes.
ofertas.error_409_plazo_abierto: The deadline to express interest is still open. You can award the post once it ends.
ofertas.error_409_propuesta_cambiada: The post changed while you were viewing it. Check the updated situation.
ofertas.error_409_respuesta_abierta: The person still has time to reply. Wait for the deadline or record their reply.
ofertas.error_409_politica_sin_plazas: This job pool’s offer policy does not allow several posts. Set up its "Posts" section and publish again.
ofertas.error_422_oferta_invalida: Check the offer and declared email. The email date cannot be in the future or after the deadline.
ofertas.error_400_solicitud_invalida: Offer or declared email details are missing. Check the form.
ofertas.error_correo: Check the date, reference and digest of the declared email.
ofertas.error_correo_referencia_personal: The email reference cannot contain an identity document number or label. Use an internal reference.
ofertas.error_503_plazo_no_configurado: This job pool’s offer policy has no deadline. Set the “Deadline to express interest” section and publish again.
ofertas.error_generico: The operation could not be completed. Check the offers before trying again.

politica_plazo.ayuda: The operational deadline starts from the date and time of the external email declared by HR. The form shows the current policy or proposes the job pool catalogue. Review and save it before publishing.

politica_plazas.aceptacion_previa: Posts are awarded among those who accepted within the deadline, by available order. No second reply is required.
politica_plazas.llamada_simultanea: At the same time: one person per vacant post
politica_plazas.llamada_sucesiva: One at a time: each post waits until the previous one is settled
politica_plazas.tras_renuncia: If someone declines or does not reply
politica_plazas.tras_renuncia_siguiente_en_orden: Call the next person for that post
politica_plazas.tras_renuncia_llamamiento_directo: That post moves to a direct call-up
